$comment: Human-facing labels for the PR comment and step summary. Machine ids (risk.json values) are fixed by the schema and cannot be renamed here.

safe.label: Safe
safe.description: No breaking change touches your code.

review.label: Review
review.description: Breaking changes need a manual check.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.description: No release notes or type definitions were found.

risky.label: Risky
risky.description: A breaking change affects code in this repo.

headlines.safe: Safe to merge: no breaking changes touch your code.
headlines.review: {prose} need a manual check: no code location to search for.
headlines.partial: Evidence is partial for at least one major upgrade, so a manual check is needed.
headlines.unknown: No release notes or type definitions were found, so the risk is unknown.
